stories.title: Gazaanse student in Maastricht geschorst na video over Hamas-aanslagen 7 oktober

en.title: Gaza student in Maastricht suspended after video about October 7 Hamas attacks
en.summary: A student from Gaza studying in Maastricht was suspended following a video posted on social media in which he claimed involvement in the October 7 Hamas attacks on Israel.

stories.title: Politie rukt massaal uit voor ‘groot incident’ in de buurt van Britse luchtmachtbasis die VS ook gebruiken

en.title: Police respond massively to 'major incident' near British air base also used by US
en.summary: Police deployed in large numbers to respond to a significant incident occurring near a British military air base utilized by the United States.

stories.title: Spanningen in Noord-Ierland lopen op rond protestantse Oranjemars die voor het eerst in bijna dertig jaar door katholieke wijk mag voeren

en.title: Tensions rise in Northern Ireland over Protestant Orange march through Catholic area for first time in nearly thirty years
en.summary: Residents of a Catholic neighborhood in Portadown, Northern Ireland plan to block a march by Protestant loyalists despite court approval. The Northern Ireland premier expressed concerns that allowing the march raises questions about the Good Friday Agreement.

stories.title: Student in Maastricht geschorst na claim over deelname aan Hamas-aanslagen

en.title: Student in Maastricht suspended after claim of participation in Hamas attacks
en.summary: Maastricht University suspended a student from Gaza following removal of a social media video in which he claimed involvement in the October 7 Hamas attacks on Israel, citing concerns for campus safety.

stories.title: Gazaanse student in Maastricht geschorst na video waarin hij 7 oktober toejuicht

en.title: Gaza student in Maastricht suspended after video in which he cheers October 7
en.summary: A Gaza student at Maastricht University was suspended after posting an Instagram video claiming he participated in the October 7 attack on Israel, in which approximately twelve hundred people died.

stories.title: 2.000 mensen bijeen in Noord-Ierse stad om omstreden Oranjemars te stoppen

en.title: 2,000 people gather in Northern Irish city to stop controversial Orange march
en.summary: Thousands assembled in Portadown, Northern Ireland to block an Orange Order march, a Protestant procession permitted to pass through a Catholic neighborhood for the first time in 28 years.

stories.title: Urenlange patstelling bij omstreden Oranjemars in Noord-Ierland

en.title: Hours-long standoff at controversial Orange march in Northern Ireland
en.summary: Supporters and opponents of a controversial Orange march in Portadown have been in a standoff for hours, with around 2,000 counter-protesters blocking the Protestant procession's route through a Catholic neighborhood.

stories.title: Arrestaties na 'groot incident' bij Britse basis die VS mag gebruiken in Iranoorlog

en.title: Arrests after 'major incident' at British base used by US in Iran war
en.summary: Multiple men were arrested Sunday for violating explosives laws at RAF Fairford, a US-used airbase in the UK. Authorities described it as a major incident and evacuated nearby residents to a recreation center.

stories.title: Groot alarm en arrestaties bij Britse luchtmachtbasis, mogelijk explosieven in auto's

en.title: Major alert and arrests at British air force base, possible explosives in vehicles
en.summary: British authorities launched a major alert at an air force base in Gloucestershire regarding a security incident, with bomb disposal experts investigating whether vehicles near the facility contain explosives.

stories.title: Zeventien doden bij schietpartij in café Zuid-Afrika, politie start klopjacht

en.title: Seventeen dead in shooting at South African café, police launch manhunt
en.summary: Armed gunmen opened fire at a café west of Johannesburg on Saturday evening, killing seventeen people and injuring fifteen others. Police launched a manhunt for the perpetrators.

stories.title: Omstreden Oranjemars Noord-Ierland mag na nachtelijk vonnis toch doorgaan

en.title: Controversial Orange march in Northern Ireland permitted to proceed after overnight ruling
en.summary: A Protestant Orange march is taking place in Portadown for the first time in 28 years through a Catholic neighborhood, allowed under strict conditions including morning timing and a limit of 35 participants.

stories.title: Wereldtitel wielrennen voor Demi Vollering, na zinderende finale

en.title: World cycling title for Demi Vollering after thrilling finale
en.summary: Demi Vollering secured her first world championship gold medal at the road cycling world championships in Canada with a dominant performance.
